description:
Use this when the user wants platforms side by side: "which platform got the most views for this clip",
"TikTok vs Shorts vs Reels this month". Per platform: posts, average views at 1 hour, 24 hours and 7 days, the
latest engagement counts (null when the platform sends none) and what it counts as a view. Platforms count
views differently: compare each against its own history and do not add them up.
Not for: single posts (get_post_stats) or the recap (weekly_report). Free and read only.

clip_id.description: Id of one clip, from list_clips, to compare where it was posted. Empty covers all posts.

days.description: Look back this many days, 1 to 90. Ignored when clip_id is given.
